lines: Nervous Sister of Parvos voice lines.
These voice lines are affected by the Progenitor Warframe's element used to kill the Candidate.
- "Did you ever sit alone in the office with a plasmic hole punch, just punching holes in other people's things? Over and over?"
- "Funny things, fingers. Get them cold enough, and they just snap right off. Like fish sticks."
- "Oh, I am operating at charge levels way above the recommended safe rate!"
- "I wonder what happens when you get hot. Does stuff start bubbling up through your armor plates? Can we find out?"
- "You realize I'm literally toxic now? I can make you foam and see pretty colors while you die."
- "I can make your shields collapse like a derivatives bubble. You don't even know what that is, do you?"
- "How do I achieve this beautiful glow? Simple. Every day I affirm the truth of Parvos's teachings in my heart. And I'm suffused with radioactivity!"
- "Do you ever clean this squalid little ship?"
- "Idle. That's what Parvos would call your sort. Expect everything to be handed to you on a plate. Those days are over, bucko."
- "Ready for another round of relentless persecution? I am."
- "I love my work. You envy me, I know. And that's okay."
- "You're really not the kind of person who itemizes their storage, are you?"
- "Shall we schedule a meeting soon? Maybe one of those fun informal ones where one of us DIES?"
- "Bom pom pom... taking over the System, one sector at a time, keeping the Tenno distracted, making all their stuff mine... oh, I am GOOD at this."
- Dialogue is randomly pulled from #Birth of Sister of Parvos, #After Logging In, #Spawning, and #Taunts sections.

path: Navigating controlled sectors in the Star Chart
lines: - "I'm in charge! And it's all going SWIMMINGLY."
- "With Parvos Granum calling the shots, everyone will benefit! Especially his loyal Sisterhood. Conspiracy is such an ugly word."
- "Observe. This sector belongs to Parvos Granum first, to the Corpus Administration second, and to you not at all."
- "This sector is under new management. And about time, too."
- "Finally, some competent administration. Any complaints can be filed in the usual bin."

path: Completing a Mission on an affected Node
lines: - "These used to be yours, but now they are not yours. Are we clear?"
- "And that's my share. See? We can work together."
- "I have restructured your finances. I have issued receipts. And there is nothing you can do about it."
- "I'll put these to responsible use. Which is more than you would have done."

path: After Revealing a Requiem Mod / Upgrade Rank of the Sister of Parvos
lines: - "Why are you trying to crack top-level Granum security? Are you deranged?"
- "Yes, yes, this was funny for a while, but you can stop now."
- "Oh, trying to guess my password? Yawn."
- "You're wasting your time, you know. This is com-plete-ly futile. You might as well be knitting socks for the Entrati."
- "Right. That's it. I tried being reasonable. But you've gone and pushed it too far."
- "I don't want to kill you, you know. So you could always just leave. Then I wouldn't have to!"
- "Right. Combat mode. Think empowering thoughts! Power flows through me."
- "I am open to this combat experience - I will learn from this combat experience - I am ready for this combat... ergh!"
- "Focus. It's only a Tenno. We kill them all the time."
- "I warn you, I'm a lot stronger than I look!"
- "A Sister of Parvos is an official position. So you see, I'm officially killing you. Perhaps that will be some comfort."
- "Have you met my Hound? A gormless mass of metallized flesh that follows me around everywhere? You two have a lot in common."
- "Look, I am actually going to hurt you quite badly, and it's only fair to let you know that."
- "I'm sorry! It's too late for mediation! You've escalated this situation waaaaay beyond the original remit!"
- "You represent an embarrassing mistake. And what do we do with those, Sisters? We shred them."
- "If I can face a disciplinary meeting with Sister Glarios, I can certainly face the likes of you!"

path: After Health Bar Segment is depleted and Hound Self-Detonates
After Attacking with Correct Requiem Mod
lines: - "Wait. Wait. Stop. I'm going to throw up."
- "What if you kill me, and I just come back even more powerful? Is that what you want? IS IT?"
- "Sorry, didn't quite catch that, could you repeat? 'Flaily flaily bleed bleed'? Ah, thought so."
- "Oh no, no, you're getting blood and bits of yourself all over the place. Do you have to?"
- "You know, I don't think that armor's quite up to snuff. Might want to report that."
- "Be a good Tenno and give the floor a clean while you're down there, eh?"
- "Is... is it dead? It's dead! It's over. Oh, thank blessed Parvos."
- "Job done. Ticky box. Call a cleaning drone."
- "I think we both knew how this was going to end, didn't we?"
- "I just got promooo-ted! Don't be bitter, Tenno. You can't be a loser forever."
- "More power? Don't mind if I do."
- "Another promotion! This partnership is going places."
- "There's nothing like having your hard work recognized, is there? Like you'd know."
- "The industrious reap the reward, the idle look on and covet. It's all there in The Founder's Tenets, you know."
- "At last, the pinnacle! And I could never have done it without using you as my footstool."
- "Parvos sees me! He takes me in his golden hand and he raises... me... up!"
- "Get back up and fight, you useless object!"
- "But... that thing was built to be warframe resistant..."
- "That's technically my kill. I get credit."
- "Not bad! I should upgrade this thing!"
- "Gotta get some use out of this thing!"
- "Oh, we're not done. We are a long way from done!"
- "Get me out of here! I said, GET ME OUUUUT!"

path: After failing the mission due to fighting the Sister
lines: - "I know you're probably upset about what just happened, so let me be the first to say it... I forgive you... Your Turn!"
- "So I think we both learned something from that. Surprised you, didn't I?"
- "Look at you, bouncing back after a defeat! I think we're developing a healthy respect for one another!"

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
lines: - "Ah, Tenno, I see you have blundered into my lair! Prepare to perish in agony! What do you think? Was that too much?"
- "Tenno. Let me explain this in words you will understand. My ship is very big. Your ship is very little."
- "Tenno, are you demented? Do you have the slightest idea how many lethal weapons are on this thing? Should I send you over the documentation?"
- "Oh, look. It's Stabby Parazon-Pants the Stabbing Stabber of Stabsville. Planning on doing a little stabbing, were you?"
- "I am in control. This battle is happening on MY terms. I am a motivated self-starter who can think on her feet."

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
lines: - "Let's launch a Crewship. That'll keep them busy."
- "Remember, Crewship, your families get no compensation if you fail today!"

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
lines: - "Brave Corpus fighter pilots, get out there and earn your pay."
- "Your proud moment has come, fighter squadron number one-more-than-the-last-one!"

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
lines: - "Ramsled full of angry people, coming towards you, quickly."
- "Good luck, Ramsledders! With you in spirit!"

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
lines: - "Just remember, Tenno. You started this. And you'll only have yourself to blame."
- "You're making a big mistake here, Tenno! I'm a strong, confident Sister at the height of her power! And you're... not."

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
lines: - "Think! When has killing me ever, EVER worked? Not once! So why don't you just go home, eh?"
- ""Self-destruct activated. All personnel evacuate." Oh no! Hurry, everyone! Let's all get off this ship before it explodes!"

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
Arriving at the Sister of Parvos
lines: - "Mighty Parvos. My desire this day is... not to die. And I grasp it."
- "Whatever happens here, I think we've both learned a lot. Haven't we?"

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
lines: - "You're not displaying very flexible thinking here, you know! Always it's straight to the violence!"
- "You'll meet a bad end, you will! Bullies always do!"
- "No no no, wait, just let me ex—"
- "No, Tenno, it's me, you can't have meant to— oh."
- "Oh thank you, thank you, oh you won't regret this."
- "Yes! For a moment there, I thought you were going to... well. Moving on."
- "Thank you so much for this opportunity. I believe my former experience makes me the ideal candidate to join your team, and I can't wait to get started!"

path: When Converted Sister of Parvos Assists the Player
lines: - "I'm here! I'm sorry I'm late; I had a thing."
- "I will prove my worth to you, so help me."
- "Boss! Looking forward to leveraging our strengths in this challenging combat experience."
- "Here we go! This is what I signed up for!"

path: When Converted Sister of Parvos Assists the Player
lines: - "Job done. I look forward to receiving my performance assessment."
- "So, now I'm all done with work, I was thinking we could... oh, never mind."
- "Welp, looks like I'm done here. Nothing else to stick around for. Unless...? Nah."

path: When Converted Sister of Parvos Assists the Player
lines: - "I'm fine! I can do this! I can— GACK"
- "Sorry, boss, think I might be dying. Yyyuup."
- "Bugs! They're inside me, crawling in my tubing!"
- "What is the point of still having organic parts if they're just going to break out in hives?"
- "Sorry! Skipped breakfast. You know how it is."
- "Mm. You're more than usually pungent today, Tenno."
- "Oh dear, Tenno. What have you been rolling in?"
- "I'm sorry; this is a completely inappropriate mismatch of power levels, and I am therefore leaving immediately. Goodbye."
- "...ah. It appears I am severely under-equipped for this assignment. Terminating."
- "Vandalizing company property, is it? I'm leaving... to file a report."
- "Impressive. I'm just going to pop off and update your file. Don't wait up!"
- "I could really use some colleague's support here!"
- "No. This is wrong. This was not a solo assignment!"
- "I can't deal with children! I'm not certified!"
- "Child. CHILD. I will NOT have mucky little fingerprints all over my screens."
- "Nausea meds! No, these are bullets. Where are my nausea meds?"
- "This drop is not safe! Where is the damn handrail?"
- "Not kubrows! Please! Their little eyes and their squashed-up faces! Oh, I don't want that to be the last thing I see!"
- "Calm, just imagine it gutted and skinned and spread out on the office floor. No, no! It's looking at me!"
- "The vacuum of space is out there. I am in here. It cannot suck my eyeballs out. But... what if it did?"
- "Why is space so quiet??? It makes me think I can hear... things."
- "Is it Bring Your Disgusting Spawn to Work Day?"
- "There is a child running about here. We'll have to fumigate."
- "Oh, someone sent me some tubemen for target practice!"
- "Just a moment, Tenno. Some Grineer have got in, and this Sister of Parvos needs to take out the trash."
- "Oh, that is just gross! It's got to go."
- "We've got Infestation! Putrid, scabby, masses of— ahhh! Clean it all out!"
- "Seeya, losers. I'll handle this by myself."
- "I'll just have to put on my big pants and handle this personally."
- "I see you, passing notes, whispering. Do you think I'm stupid?"
- "Guess what, staff? It's time for a random loyalty test! Anyone still alive after this, has passed!"
- "Come on, push me over again! I'm having FUN."
- "Burn! Burn it all! Burn it like I burned my dream journals!"
- "I can hear Parvos speaking to me from the flames, and he tells me I am worthy!"
- "Ooh, this place is crawling with wildlife. Do I have to clean it up myself?"
- "There's my new desk ornament! Just need to make it a little more dead."
- "Nothing wrong with wearing your wealth, Tenno. And my enhancements are mine."
